items.title: The Neuron Academy launches practical AI courses
points: New learning platform offers short courses (~15 minutes each) on prompt writing, research, and task automation, focused on real-world application rather than theory
No technical background required; learning paths organized by goal or browsable full catalog
Reader Tyler completed courses and built his own to show how he uses AI in his corporate job
Aims to bridge the gap between newsletter tips and actual on-the-job implementation, addressing reader feedback about lacking clear how-to steps
